title: Checkout failures caused by database connection exhaustion
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by long-running transactions and insufficient available connections.
resolution: Identified long-running transactions, increased connection pool capacity within database limits, and restarted affected application instances.

title: Order creation failures due to Redis outage
root_cause: Redis dependency became unavailable to order-service instances.
resolution: Restored Redis availability and validated application connectivity and order creation after recovery.

title: Payment timeouts caused by external gateway degradation
root_cause: External payment gateway experienced elevated latency and intermittent service failures.
resolution: Confirmed gateway degradation, monitored provider recovery, and relied on supported retry behavior without aggressively increasing retry volume.

title: User profile latency caused by slow database queries
root_cause: Database query latency increased because of inefficient queries and database workload pressure.
resolution: Identified slow queries, optimized the affected queries, and monitored database latency after the change.

title: Inventory failures caused by downstream dependency outage
root_cause: A downstream warehouse inventory dependency experienced service degradation.
resolution: Confirmed downstream dependency degradation, restored connectivity, and validated inventory requests after recovery.

title: Notification delays caused by queue backlog
root_cause: Notification consumers were processing messages below the incoming message rate, causing queue backlog.
resolution: Scaled notification consumers and monitored queue depth until the backlog returned to normal.

title: Search failures caused by unhealthy cluster node
root_cause: One or more search cluster nodes became unhealthy and affected shard availability.
resolution: Recovered unhealthy nodes and affected shards, then verified cluster health and search latency.

title: Authentication failures caused by identity provider outage
root_cause: The identity provider became unavailable, preventing reliable token validation.
resolution: Confirmed identity provider outage, monitored recovery, and validated authentication after service restoration.

title: Recommendation latency caused by resource saturation
root_cause: Recommendation workloads saturated available CPU and memory resources.
resolution: Scaled recommendation service capacity and investigated the workload responsible for sustained resource consumption.

title: Checkout errors caused by deployment configuration regression
symptoms: Checkout error rate increased after deployment
root_cause: A configuration change introduced in a new checkout deployment caused application failures.
resolution: Compared the current deployment with the previous known-good release and rolled back the configuration and application version.

title: Order failures requiring additional investigation
root_cause: Could not be established from the initial evidence.
resolution: Collected request IDs, exact error messages, affected endpoints, and additional dependency information before continuing diagnosis.

title: Payment incident with conflicting gateway and application evidence
root_cause: Could not be confidently established because external gateway degradation and internal resource pressure occurred simultaneously.
resolution: Collected request-level evidence and timing information before selecting a remediation path.
